formal_conclusion: 在有限内部成员扩展和严格训练折内类别校准后，TabPFN-3仍未达到T-MEL软概率教师标准，因此停止原始TabPFN概率蒸馏方案，不再继续调参。

operational_definitions_fixed_before_int.class_sacrifice: pooled ACC increases while any class recall decreases by more than 0.02
operational_definitions_fixed_before_int.fold_volatility_worsened: calibrated fold ACC sample SD exceeds selected raw SD by more than 0.01
operational_definitions_fixed_before_int.meaningful_nonzero_exclusive: at least one calibrated-only correct sample versus Original or SEPS
operational_definitions_fixed_before_int.no_anomalous_fold: all ten folds complete validation and fold ACC >= 0.80
operational_definitions_fixed_before_int.paired_clearly_favors_original_and_seps: for both comparisons, other-only correct exceeds calibrated-only correct by at least 5

stop_reasons: paired correct-only counts favor both Original and SEPS by at least 5
